mentions.name: Elliptic curves for programmers
mentions.description: An educational video introduction to elliptic curve arithmetic for programmers, part of the 3Blue1Brown Summer of Math Exposition. In about ten minutes it walks through writing a legal bitcoin wallet bruteforcer in the C language.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm editing my 3B1B summer of math exposition video: Elliptic curves for programmers

It's a motivated video introduction to Elliptic curve arithmetic where in 10 minutes we write (in the C language) a legal bitcoin wallet bruteforcer.
